title: Tokenizer
description: Fiori tokenizer: a keyboard-navigable token list that collapses into an "n more" link with a popover of all tokens.

usage.summary: Manage keyboard navigation, selection and overflow for existing tokens.
useWhen: Let users inspect, select and remove a group of values already represented by tokens.
Keep overflowed values reachable through the more-items indicator.
Remove caller-owned tokens in onTokenDelete after users request deletion.

avoidWhen.when: Enter new free-form or caller-validated values with optional suggestions.
Add values from a predefined filterable option list.
Show only one independently managed selected value.
